Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.ssh

Class SshSession

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.ssh.SshSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SshSession extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Manages a single SSH connection lifecycle: connect, shell I/O, keepalive, port forwarding, and graceful disconnect.

State machine: DISCONNECTED -> CONNECTING -> CONNECTED -> DISCONNECTING -> DISCONNECTED. All blocking I/O runs on JDK 21 virtual threads; the keepalive pinger uses a shared ScheduledExecutorService.

Security: host keys are verified trust-on-first-use via KnownHostsManager with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes. Passwords are passed as byte[] to JSch to avoid retaining immutable Strings. Secrets are zeroed after connect.
